newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France drains 46.1 bln Ffr at tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France drains 46.1 bln Ffr at tender.

text.p: The Bank of France drained 46.1 billion francs at a securities repurchase tender held on Tuesday to allocate funds for injection into the money market on Wednesday.
It accepted bids for 46.0 billion francs in new liquidity, 46.1 billion less than the 92.1 billion leaving the market on Wednesday when a previous pact expires. The new pact expires on July 22.
The Bank of France said it allocated 13.7 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 9.0 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 32.3 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 22.2 percent of this demand.
There is no money market tender on Thursday.
